extracted.intended_audience: French public officials, elected officials and their advisers; lobbyists/representatives of interests; actors subject to foreign-influence rules; civil society organizations; journalists and members of the public seeking information on transparency obligations
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the missions, obligations and institutional arrangements of La Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP), including registries (lobbying, foreign influence), asset declarations, conflict-of-interest prevention, mobility controls, and integrity promotion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organisation (composition and case examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: L’institution — La Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique est composée d’un collège qui examine les dossiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the Authority's institutional organisation: a collegiate body is responsible for examining files and delivering decisions/deliberations. (Governance/decision-making structure for oversight actions.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence of the Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Indépendance — La Haute Autorité pour la transparence de la vie publique (HATVP) est une autorité administrative indépendante (AAI) chargée…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States that HATVP is an independent administrative authority, implying decisions and controls are to be exercised independently from political influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control of public/private mobility (post‑office reconversion oversight)
rubrics_metrics.description: Le contrôle de la mobilité public/privé — La Haute Autorité contrôle depuis sa création la reconversion professionnelle des anciens ministres, Présidents d’exécutifs locaux et membres…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HATVP monitors and controls professional reconversion of certain senior officials (former ministers, local executives, cabinet members) to prevent conflicts arising from movement between public office and private sector employment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prevention of conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: La prévention des conflits d’intérêts — En plus de renforcer le contrôle du patrimoine des responsables publics, les lois de 2013 sur la transparence…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HATVP's role includes preventing conflicts of interest through strengthened asset controls and other measures introduced by the 2013 transparency laws; implies standards for identifying and managing conflicts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Control and declaration of patrimony (asset declarations)
rubrics_metrics.description: Le contrôle du patrimoine — Depuis l’entrée en vigueur des lois du 11 octobre 2013 relatives à la transparence de la vie publique,…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since the 11 October 2013 laws, public officials are required to make asset/declaration filings which HATVP controls and reviews; guidance and practical sheets (fiches pratiques) explain obligations and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration requirement for representatives of interests (lobbyists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Le répertoire des représentants d’intérêts — Depuis le 1er juillet 2017, les représentants d’intérêts sont tenus de s’inscrire sur un répertoire numérique, dans lequel…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since 1 July 2017, representatives of interests must register in a digital registry; the page references a 'définition stricte' under law n°2016-1691 (9 December 2016) that defines who must register. Includes practical guidance (fiches pratiques) about obligations and how to consult the registry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal definition and limits for lobbyists (law n°2016-1691)
rubrics_metrics.description: Une définition stricte — La loi n° 2016-1691 du 9 décembre 2016 relative à la transparence, à la lutte contre la corruption…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points to the statutory (strict) definition of 'représentants d’intérêts' in law 2016-1691; this defines scope of obligations (who is covered) and the legal requirements for registration and conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registry and oversight of foreign influence actors
rubrics_metrics.description: Le répertoire de l’influence étrangère — La loi n° 2024-850 du 25 juillet 2024 visant à prévenir les ingérences étrangères en France confie à…
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Law 2024-850 (25 July 2024) creates obligations for actors of foreign influence to be registered and places oversight responsibilities with HATVP; the Authority provides practical sheets and a registry for consultation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotion and diffusion of a culture of integrity (advice, training, partnerships)
rubrics_metrics.description: La diffusion d’une culture de l’intégrité — Découvrir les missions de conseil et de formation de la Haute Autorité; Le conseil déontologique; La coopération avec la société civile
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HATVP's missions include advisory and training activities, acting as a 'partner déontologique' to public officials and institutions, and maintaining links with civil society (e.g., via agrément/accreditation) to promote transparency and ethical standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provision of practical guidance and legal/deontological resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiches pratiques / Espace juridique et déontologique — En savoir plus sur les obligations des responsables publics; Consulter les textes de références et les délibérations de la Haute Autorité.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HATVP publishes practical guides ('fiches pratiques'), legal texts, deliberations and opinions to explain obligations, procedures and standards (useful for compliance, consultation of declarations and registries).
